adaptationHealthRestore:
Instantly restores %(immediatelyRestore)s of the vehicle's hit points. Throughout the ability's %(duration)s s duration, all incoming damage from shells and combat abilities will be accumulated and converted into hit points plus additional %(restoringCoefficient)s of the total received damage once the ability runs out.

*Converted HP recovery also affects ally vehicles within a small range.
additInvisibilityDeviceBattleBooster: Increases the concealment of a stationary or moving vehicle
additionalInvisibilityDevice: Increases the concealment of a stationary or moving vehicle.
afterburning: Boosts the speed and acceleration of your vehicle for a limited time.
aimingStabilizerBattleBooster: Improves the effect of the stabilizer
antifragmentationLining: Protects the vehicle and crew from HE shells, injuries, stunning, and ramming
berserker:
Increases penetration and fire rate by %(gunPiercing)s times, while also increasing gun laying efficiency and stabilization by %(gunAimingTime)s, but takes away %(healthDebuff)s of your vehicle's total HP within its duration of %(duration)s s.

*Damage caused by the Berserker ability cannot destroy your vehicle.
br_bomber:
Stuns and causes %(minDamage)s to %(maxDamage)s HP of damage to enemy vehicles. Vehicles in the center of the impact area are damaged more severely.

*There is a %(delay)s s delay before impact.
br_minefield:
Deploys an active minefield in the selected area for %(duration)s s. Enemy vehicles that come into contact with the mines will be stunned and receive explosive damage.

*The mines can be destroyed by shooting. Mines deployed under enemy vehicles will NOT explode.
br_smoke: Adds a concealment bonus to all vehicles within range of the consumable.
br_smoke_with_damage:
Adds a concealment bonus to all vehicles within range of the consumable, as well as damaging ALL vehicles within its range by %(damagePerTick)s of their total HP per second. Lasts for %(duration)s s.

*Corrosive Mist damage does not interrupt loot pickup and does not destroy vehicles, leaving them at least 1 HP.
brRegenerationKit: Gradually restores %(healPerTickDuration)s of the vehicle's HP within %(duration)s s. Can be interrupted by taking damage.
brRepairkit: Repairs modules and removes negative effects.

chocolate: Improves the performance of German crews
clingBrander:
Calls in an autonomous tank equipped with an Identification Friend or Foe system that will pursue and attack the nearest enemy for up to %(botLifeTime)s s.

corrodingShot:

*The negative effect can be removed by a Repair Kit.
